deviations.applied: semantic ANSI slots chosen by Claude Code
deviations.reason: Claude Code colours highlighted code from fixed ANSI slots that a theme cannot override; the terminal spec lets programs choose slot semantics.
Claude Code draws OSC 8 links in bright blue (slot 12) regardless of theme.

deviations.target: line + and - markers, file preview colours
deviations.applied: host-selected ANSI slots or inherited row foreground
deviations.reason: Line-marker rendering depends on Claude Code renderer and syntax path; no independent line-marker theme key exists. The +N/-N edit summary is separately reached through the shared word-emphasis tokens.

Claude Code 2.1.303 reuses diffAddedWord/diffRemovedWord for summary foreground and word background. Dedicated shared-word roles balance both at about 3:1 for black and ordinary rose; neither a 4.5:1 pass nor a guarantee for every syntax foreground. No separate summary or word-foreground setting exists.
Claude Code colours the selected item's text only; it has no selection-fill token for pickers.

deviations.specValue: a distinct border for a distinct input mode
deviations.reason: j3w1 defines one focused-input border; the `!` prompt marker carries the mode.
Claude Code shares permission between dialog borders and inline-code text. Strong red preserves readable inline code while keeping dialogs red.
Named agent hues follow the semantic terminal palette (D-041); normal and bright pairs may share values, so names and labels remain the identity channel.

deviations.applied: color.code.selection-bg; spans keep their own colour
deviations.reason: Claude Code has only a selection-background token; spans keep their own foreground. Contrast depends on each foreground, the selection fill and any host dimming; no selection-text override exists.
